{{Quote|If they open the hatches before our frost bath, we go for them, agreed?|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to [[Droma]]|<ref name="JE">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos II: Jedi Eclipse]]''</ref>}}
A '''frost bath''' was the name given to the numbing chemical solution used by the [[87-RM Scout Collector]] as part of its flash-freezing process. Once a creature was placed inside the internal cubical storage area, the temperature dropped rapidly, inducing cryogenic [[Hypothermia/Legends|hypothermia]]. Sprayer nozzles then released the frost bath solution, placing the creature in perfect stasis for transport.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
